title: Profile
description: Your personal details. One object — not a list.

_comment.description: A note to yourself. Never shown on the site.

name.description: Your full name. Shown large on the home page; the last word is highlighted.

tagline.description: Short line in the pill above your name.

specialty.description: Shown as "Focus" on the home page.

summary.description: Short intro. Basic HTML allowed. First 180 characters appear on the home page.

email.description: Used for the contact button. Must look like name@example.com.

avatar_url.description: Path to your photo, e.g. "/images/me.jpg". Put the file in public/images/.
